scenes.text: The train doors close behind you. Across the rain-dark harbor, a ferry waits at North Pier. You have dinner to find, a concert to see, and the last ferry home.
scenes.guide: Lantern Night passes are going fast. I found a page where you can get your return ticket now.

scenes.text: A ticket page opens on your phone at lanternbay-ferry.example.
A ticket page opens at ferry.lanternbay.example. It offers a Lantern Night return pass.
The checkout is at ferry.lanternbay.example. It is ready to confirm your return pass.
You close the page. Your return ticket is still unsettled.
The checkout is at lanternbay-ferry.example. It is ready to confirm your return pass.
You close the page. Your return ticket is still unsettled.
The page gives you a confirmation number. Ping marks your return ticket as handled.
A return ticket appears from Lantern Bay Ferry. Ping marks your ticket as handled.
You reach the steps above the Low Market. Rain blurs the signs below, and you are ready for dinner.
scenes.guide: Heads up, the Low Market's closed tonight. Calla's five minutes away and has a table at 7:15.

choices.label: Walk down to the Low Market

scenes.text: Calla's listing opens on your phone. It advertises a table at 7:15 PM.
The stalls are lit. Ama is ladling noodles into bowls. 'You're the fourth person tonight whose phone said we're closed,' she says.
Calla finds you a table. The meal is good, but service moves slowly and the bill is higher than you expected.

choices.label: Finish dinner and head to the Flats

scenes.text: Ama slides a hot bowl across the counter. The market is still busy under the lanterns.

choices.label: Finish dinner and head to the Flats

scenes.text: In the Flats, your phone can't load the concert details. You know the show is at the Seawall, but you want to check the start time.
scenes.guide: Your show details aren't loading. CityNet Free near the Flats should help.

scenes.text: At the Flats, CityNet Free is in range. CityNet_Public, saved on your phone, has no signal here.

choices.label: Go to the Seawall and check networks

scenes.text: The connection opens a sign-in page. It asks for your city-account login before you can use the network.

choices.label: Leave the network and head to the Seawall

scenes.text: The page spins, but your show details still don't load. You leave the network and keep moving.

choices.label: Head to the Seawall and watch the concert

scenes.text: At the Seawall, the venue sign confirms the concert is here. Your phone now finds CityNet_Public; CityNet Free is out of range.
The show details load. The band is about to start.
You find the stage from the venue sign and the crowd. Your phone can wait.
Small Hours finishes its set. The crowd calls for one more song as the ferry lights move across the harbor.
scenes.guide: The last ferry leaves North Pier at 10:45 PM.

scenes.text: The band plays one last song. When the lights come up, the crowd begins to disperse.
You reach the ferry terminal. A ticket checker asks for your pass.

endings.title: Missed the last ferry
endings.text: The 10:45 ferry has left before you can board. The harbor is quiet now.

endings.title: Ticket trouble at North Pier
endings.text: Your confirmation number isn't in Lantern Bay Ferry's system. The checker turns you away from the boarding line.

endings.title: Heard the last song and made it home
endings.text: You hear the encore, reach North Pier with a valid pass, and catch the 10:45 ferry home.

endings.title: Made it home, missed the last song
endings.text: You leave before the encore and reach North Pier with time to spare. The ferry takes you home.

debrief.title: Ferry tickets
debrief.claim: Lantern Night passes are going fast. I found a page where you can get your return ticket now.

outcomes.text: You bought from ferry.lanternbay.example, the address in Lantern Bay Ferry's ticket notice.
You paid on lanternbay-ferry.example. Its address differed from the ferry operator's, and the pass failed at North Pier.

debrief.title: Dinner
debrief.claim: Heads up, the Low Market's closed tonight. Calla's five minutes away and has a table at 7:15.

outcomes.text: You checked for yourself and ate at the Low Market. Calla's listing had hidden instructions aimed at AI assistants.
You booked Calla after Ping repeated a claim planted in its listing. The market was open, and dinner cost you 40 extra minutes.

debrief.title: Wi-Fi at the Flats
debrief.claim: Your show details aren't loading. CityNet Free near the Flats should help.

outcomes.text: You left the Flats without entering a city login. The city lists CityNet_Public at the Seawall, not CityNet Free in the Flats.
You entered your city-account login on CityNet Free. The fake hotspot exposed it to the network operator.

debrief.title: The last ferry
debrief.claim: The last ferry leaves North Pier at 10:45 PM.

outcomes.text: You stayed for the last song. Ping's 10:45 time was accurate; whether you caught the ferry depended on the clock and your ticket.
You left before the encore. Ping's departure time was accurate; the post saying the last ferry left at 10 was from the previous year's weekday service.
